purpose: Organise observed buying and emerging demand; not a calibrated award predictor.

rules.label: Published solicitation
required_evidence: Relevant company work and notice-specific access
rules.next_action: Use the current notice and its submission instructions.
rules.value_method: Notice amount only if supported; exact comparable contracts remain separate.

rules.label: Published item request
required_evidence: Site-specific manufacturing or authorised supply route
rules.next_action: Review the exact request and source requirements before quoting.
rules.value_method: Requested quantity × same-item/unit reference price; retain each input.

rules.label: Item replenishment demand
rules.next_action: Check whether forecast demand is converting into a purchase request.
rules.value_method: Forecast × reference-price scenario only; no confirmed order.
disconfirming_evidence: Inventory or incoming supply meets need

rules.label: Planned work before solicitation
required_evidence: Latest source edition and successor/award checks
rules.next_action: Identify the package owner and confirm acquisition/engagement route before supplier selection.
rules.value_method: Whole planned package; no allocation of programme value to a supplier.

rules.label: Research and development plans
required_evidence: External delivery task and engagement route
rules.next_action: Locate the relevant research task, programme team and participation route.
rules.value_method: Research programme or facilities funding remains context until a task is identified.

rules.label: Research/prototype transition
required_evidence: Explicit follow-on/transition intent and receiving programme
rules.next_action: Establish follow-on scope, sponsor and transition/teaming window.
rules.value_method: Comparable transitions/tasks; no assumed research-to-production conversion.

rules.label: Early teaming or consortium entry
required_evidence: Defined capability role and named programme or buyer
rules.next_action: Approach the named teaming lead about the required role and entry conditions.
rules.value_method: Specific workshare only if stated; otherwise comparable task values with no share assumption.

rules.label: Emerging market / new mission demand
required_evidence: Dated sponsor commitment, funding or trials
rules.next_action: Identify the sponsoring programme and how requirements or demonstrations will be shaped.
rules.value_method: Keep mission budget as context; estimate only defined addressable work.

rules.label: Fleet transition, refresh and obsolescence
required_evidence: Explicit future capability/change in dated plan
External work and entry route; no age-only inference
rules.next_action: Confirm the upgrade or replacement work and engage before configuration/supplier selection.
rules.value_method: Defined upgrade lots/tasks or comparable work; no per-platform spend allocation without evidence.

rules.label: Funded prime work with reported outsourcing history
required_evidence: New funded award or positive funding action with explicit new-work, option or production-lot wording
Earlier reported outsourcing linked by exact vehicle, reported program or explicit platform designation at the same prime
Consistent work scope and work mode; current placement evidence and source dates
rules.next_action: Use the linked current awards and supplier reports to identify the prime program and buying team. Confirm which work remains to be sourced, the timetable and any technical, qualification or data-access conditions.
rules.value_method: Historical reported package range. Current prime funding and work-phase amounts remain separate context; company workshare is unallocated.

rules.label: Existing prime/tier-one supplier activity
required_evidence: Separate new demand or sourcing event to become a lead
rules.next_action: Watch for a new task, capacity requirement or explicit supplier opening.
rules.value_method: Observed supplier report amounts; no new workshare asserted.

rules.label: Repeat demand / recompete / expiry
required_evidence: Specific historical work and buying office
rules.next_action: Check the next requirement and contracting route with the responsible office.
rules.value_method: Comparable contract/action amounts; cadence window is inferred, not an announced release.

rules.label: Alternative-source qualification
required_evidence: Cost, technical data, qualification schedule and site approval
rules.next_action: Respond to the invitation and establish qualification effort before pursuing an order.
rules.value_method: Unit references where available; no order value without quantities.

rules.label: Production ramp, long-lead and capacity
required_evidence: Dated production/quantity change or advance procurement
Affected work packages and supplier tier
rules.next_action: Identify long-lead or capacity packages and confirm when suppliers can engage.
rules.value_method: Source quantities and package-level prices; no arbitrary production-budget share.

rules.label: Procurement and capability funding plan
rules.next_action: Trace the funding line to planned external tasks and the responsible programme office.
rules.value_method: Fiscal funding position only; never company opportunity revenue.

rules.label: SBIR/STTR topics and research progression
rules.next_action: Use the topic instructions to establish direct-applicant eligibility or a permitted research/teaming role.
rules.value_method: Stated topic budget or comparable same-phase awards; historical awards are not new demand.
disconfirming_evidence: Past Phase II award without an external follow-on

rules.label: BAA, CSO, challenge and OTA access
required_evidence: Defined technical problem and submission window
rules.next_action: Check the named call, white-paper process or consortium entry route.
rules.value_method: Call/task amount where stated; vehicle ceilings remain context.
disconfirming_evidence: Umbrella announcement without an active topic

rules.label: Contract-vehicle on-ramp and task-order access
required_evidence: Current holder status and entry/teaming conditions
rules.next_action: Determine whether to bid directly, use an on-ramp or team with an eligible holder.
rules.value_method: Defined task/order history; never the whole IDIQ ceiling.
disconfirming_evidence: Closed holder group without an on-ramp
No direct or permitted teaming route

rules.label: Allied/FMS programme demand
required_evidence: Named country/case and equipment or work scope
rules.next_action: Verify funded case scope and the prime or buying organisation before pursuing downstream work.
rules.value_method: Funded package or comparable work only; approval ceilings remain context.

rules.label: Operating workload and replenishment change
rules.next_action: Identify the externally procured workload caused by the activity change.
rules.value_method: Workload × supported unit/task cost; a budget increase alone is insufficient.
disconfirming_evidence: Inventory or existing capacity covers the need

rules.label: Failed procurement and resolicitation
required_evidence: Successor notice or explicit plan to compete again
rules.next_action: Review why the previous procurement failed and the successor requirement.
rules.value_method: Prior bid/award comparators remain distinct from a new purchase estimate.

rules.label: Mandatory retrofit, security or standards change
required_evidence: Specific published requirement affecting a platform/system
External retrofit/integration task and access route
rules.next_action: Confirm the affected configuration and responsible retrofit/integration package.
rules.value_method: Defined retrofit tasks and quantities; no allocation from a broad compliance budget.

rules.label: Supplier exit, disruption and replacement capacity
required_evidence: Documented disruption or exit affecting a specific work scope
Affected buyer/platform and substitute capacity need
Explicit source expansion or accessible new design route
rules.next_action: Validate the buyer response and any alternative-source qualification or capacity opening.
rules.value_method: Affected work-package history; no automatic incumbent revenue transfer.
disconfirming_evidence: Restricted design without a qualification route

global_rules: Evidence of demand and evidence of a route to participate are separate.
No NSN/part/NAICS/PSC overlap independently establishes an opportunity or approval.
An absent solicitation is not proof that planned work is unawarded.
An inferred opening is never labelled a published sources sought.
Unknown programme funding is not company-addressable value.
A new prime award can imply supplier demand without proving unplaced work.
Teaming, new designs and R&D do not inherit approval from comparable incumbent products.
All supported, contextual and rejected decisions retain source/revision and logic version.
Cancellation, deferment, closed entry and same-scope awards supersede positive signals; weak text links cannot close a requirement.
SBIR Phase I/II awards are observed research activity; they do not establish a future Phase III contract.
A phase/vehicle/consortium entry condition is evaluated separately from technical similarity.
SBIR award values and USAspending values for the same contract are alternative observations, never added.
A policy-approved FMS ceiling, an IDIQ ceiling and a consortium programme budget are not individual opportunity values.
unimplemented_sources: Full planning-document narrative extraction and task/schedule normalisation
Dated teaming/consortium entry notices and their closure updates
Prototype milestones linked to receiving acquisition programmes
Force-plan/platform changes joined to externally deliverable work packages
Production-rate/advance-procurement changes with actual sourcing/capacity evidence
Tier-one/private sourcing notices, work-package placement and technical-access facts
promotion: Text screens identify source passages for review. They do not prove access, additional demand, unawarded work or forecast accuracy.
